home.heroTitle: Hard days, hopeful days — we walk with you
home.heroSubtitle: Private. Culturally safe. Built for Aotearoa — for struggle and for celebration.
home.heroDescription: A sovereign, privacy-first platform for whānau of preterm twins and frontline families: services and information when the path is tough, and space to honour the milestones, firsts, and joy that belong to this chapter too.
home.intro: Navigate support with dignity. Protect what is precious. Celebrate how far you have come.

roleSelector.title: Nau mai, haere mai — Welcome
roleSelector.subtitle: Whether today feels heavy or hopeful, you are in the right place. Supporting whānau of preterm twins across Aotearoa New Zealand.
roleSelector.parentDescription: Support, information, and a place that honours both the hard work and the happy moments of your journey
roleSelector.practitionerDescription: Tools, directory management, and moderation that protect safety while uplifting whānau

features.title: Built for the whole journey
features.subtitle: Cultural safety and privacy at the centre — with room for hope, humour, and celebration.
features.privacyDescription: Your data is treated with care. Local-first patterns and consent — so you decide what is shared.
features.directoryDescription: Find services, support groups, and specialists across Aotearoa — including supports that help families stay connected and mark progress.
features.culturalDescription: Designed with Te Tiriti in mind. Designed in accordance with Te Mana Raraunga principles where Māori data interests arise.
features.supportDescription: Whānau who understand NICU nights — and the relief of good news, weight gains, and going home.
features.guidesDescription: Plain-language information reviewed with care — practical help without drowning out your own story.
features.aiDescription: A gentle, draft-only guide to navigate information — transparent, never a replacement for your care team, never the author of your joy.

values.title: What we stand for
values.subtitle: Our kaupapa holds both the struggle and the celebration.
values.manaDescription: Upholding the sovereignty and self-determination of whānau in every interaction.
values.whanauDescription: The whole whānau is supported — siblings, partners, grandparents — the people who share both the worry and the wins.
values.tikaDescription: Honest, accurate, and culturally appropriate information — always.
values.manaakiDescription: Genuine care in every feature — including the right to smile, rest, and celebrate progress.
